review_type: Repository-owner-commissioned AI-assisted Econometrica numerical-methods advisory review
recommendation: Reject in the present form; encourage a substantially focused new submission rather than another ordinary revision of the current manuscript

inspected: protocol, audit, compilation and remote-execution ledgers
primary, cost, frontier, greedy, radius and state-stress tables
performed: independent arithmetic reconstruction from committed ledgers
review of disclosed initial-state recovery and evidence binding
not_performed: independent retraining of the 90 primary policies
independent replay of all 230 raw arrays
formal verification of the interval or polynomial arithmetic runtime
independent theorem proof beyond source inspection

r10_objections_materially_resolved: The post-training certificate now distinguishes policies inside the same tube.
Ten seed-level policies replace three-actor path averaging.
An explicit continuous-time transfer account replaces an Euler-grid heuristic.
Direct-policy, affine, longer-budget and tuned greedification baselines are included.
Adverse policies, state stresses and prior negative evidence are retained.
blocking_findings: The policy-specific certificate is method-agnostic and does not identify the value of the NBO critic or Bellman update.
NBO's small advantage over direct policy optimization is not directly paired or certified; direct policy reaches the same target at lower cost.
The learned improvement closes only a small fraction of the inherited anchor regret bound and does not establish near-optimal solution accuracy.
The positive result is pointwise at y=0 and is not robust across most declared shifted and dispersed state stresses.
The deployed controller assumes direct Brownian-innovation observation without an economically justified observation model.
The manuscript remains too broad and the uncalibrated stylized application too limited for the narrow model-specific contribution.

reviewer_diagnostics.scope: Ledger arithmetic only; no retraining or independent raw-array replay.
